requirements.title: General applicability
requirements.description: The following requirements shall apply to any IR thermometer that is labeled to meet these specifications.

requirements.title: Ear canal IR thermometer displayed temperature range
requirements.description: In any display mode, an ear canal IR thermometer shall display a subject's temperature over a minimum range of 34.4 to 42.2 °C (94.0 to 108.0 °F).

requirements.title: Skin IR thermometer displayed temperature range
requirements.description: A skin IR thermometer shall display a subject's temperature over a minimum range of 22 to 40.0 °C (71.6 to 104.0 °F).

requirements.title: Maximum Permissible Laboratory Error (Ear Canal IR Thermometer)
Laboratory error δ within manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions
requirements.description: Within the manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions (see 5.6), laboratory error δ as measured according to 6.1.4 shall be no greater than values specified below.

requirements.title: Ear canal blackbody temperature range 36 to 39 °C
requirements.description: For blackbody temperature range from 36 to 39 °C (96.8 to 102.2 °F): 0.2 °C (0.4 °F).

requirements.title: Ear canal blackbody temperature outside 36-39 °C
requirements.description: For blackbody temperatures less than 36 °C (96.8 °F) or greater than 39 °C (102.2 °F): 0.3 °C (0.5 °F).

requirements.title: Maximum Permissible Laboratory Error (Skin IR Thermometer)
Skin IR thermometer laboratory error δ
requirements.description: Within the manufacturer's specified operating ambient conditions (see 5.6) over the display temperature range as specified in 5.2.2, laboratory error δ as measured according to 6.1.5 shall be no greater than 0.3 °C (0.5 °F).

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy applicability
requirements.description: The clinical accuracy requirement is applicable only to an ear canal IR thermometer system and the corresponding age groups of subjects for which such a thermometer is labeled or implied to be used.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy determination conditions
requirements.description: Clinical accuracy shall be determined separately for each of the following conditions: for each device model, for each adjusted display mode, and for every age group of febrile and afebrile subjects on which the IR thermometer is intended to be used.
requirements.result_remark: Clinical accuracy is not evaluated in this report.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy disclosure
requirements.description: Any disclosure of clinical accuracy claims shall be accompanied by disclosure of methodology and procedures. Such information shall be made available on request.

requirements.title: Clinical accuracy form
requirements.description: Clinical accuracy should be determined in the form of two characteristics — clinical bias with stated uncertainty and clinical repeatability, as defined in 3.2.9.

requirements.title: Laboratory error at operating temperature range 16 to 40 °C
requirements.description: The system shall meet laboratory error requirements as specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both, when operating in an environment from 16 to 40 °C (60.8 to 104.0 °F).

requirements.title: Labeling for narrower operating temperature range
requirements.description: If the operating temperature range is narrower than specified in 5.6.1.1, the device shall be clearly labeled with a cautionary statement of the maximum or minimum operating temperatures, or both.

requirements.title: Upper limit of operating temperature range
requirements.description: Under no circumstances may the upper limit of operating temperature range be less than 35 °C (95 °F).

requirements.title: Operating Humidity Range
requirements.description: The relative humidity range for the operating temperature range as specified in 5.6.1 is up to 95%, noncondensing.

requirements.title: Drop test with batteries installed
requirements.description: The instrument with batteries installed (if applicable) without a carrying (storage) casing shall withstand drops with controlled orientation of the device without degradation of accuracy as specified in 5.3 or 5.4, or both, for a blackbody temperature of or near 37 °C (98.6 °F), when tested according to 6.3.

requirements.title: Shock detection mechanism
requirements.description: If an IR thermometer does not meet the requirement of 5.6.3.1, a means of detecting and informing the user of its inoperable state, after being subjected to shock, shall be provided.

requirements.title: Storage Conditions
requirements.description: The instrument shall meet the accuracy requirements of 5.3 or 5.4, or both, after having been stored or transported, or both, at any point in an environment of -20 to +50 °C (-4 to +122 °F) and relative humidity up to 95%, noncondensing, for a period of one month. The test procedure is specified in 6.1.6.

If the operating temperature range is narrower than 16 to 40 °C (60.8 to 104.0 °F) as specified in 5.6.1.1, the device shall be clearly labeled with a cautionary statement of the maximum or minimum operating temperatures, or both.
